title: Quick Pungent Filipino Snow Peas Soup
description: A velvety, pungent soup that brightens any sick day, featuring snow peas, coconut milk, and a touch of soy sauce.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat and sauté onion, garlic, ginger, and carrot until fragrant.
Add the snow peas, soy sauce, and fish sauce to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 6 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Place a heatproof bowl over a pot of simmering water, creating a bain-marie, and gently warm the coconut milk.
Carefully pour the warm coconut milk into the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the bay leaf, salt, and pepper, and simmer for an additional 4 minutes.
Remove the pot from heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Use an immersion blender to purée the soup until velvety smooth, or transfer to a blender in batches.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
